title: 第3章 街头画家第4章 符篆师宝典
lines: 第3章街头画家
百城中心，最大的广场上，白牧野支着画板坐在一个角落在那里发呆。
我还是个孩子啊！
孩子的任务，不就是好好学习，剩下时间用来各种浪的吗？
其他的事情不都是家长的责任么？
为什么要这样残忍的对待孩子？
这些年他连门都很少出，所有一切都是老头子负责，哪来的钱？
因为账户里一分钱都没有，他甚至连信用点都不能透支。
老头子现在突然间给他来这么一出，直接打了他一个措手不及。
别说思考自己身世来历，就连老头子留给他的那部符篆师宝典都没时间去看。
更没精力去伤心老头子的突然离去。
他是不是故意用这种方式磨砺我？同时让我没那么伤心他的离开？
呸！
还伤心个屁啊！
简直要把人给坑死的节奏！
幸好还有点本事，不然的话，不但交不起房租，恐怕就连肚子都要填不饱了。
画符先画画！
精神力是符篆师的基础，绘画功底，同样也是！
一个厉害的画家未必是符篆师，但一个厉害的符篆师，绝对是厉害的画家。
记得老头子跟他说过，他的画技已经登堂入室，可以媲美一些小有名气的画家了。
在时间紧迫，想不到其他谋生手段的情况下，他只能想到来百城卖画了。
可问题是，一张画应该卖多少钱？
能不能在开学之前赚够下个月的房租？
他一点底都没有。
而且理想总是丰满的，现实却骨感的很，比那些瘦得狼看见都想哭的姑娘还要骨感。
瘦到那种地步的姑娘其实除了自己之外，没几个人会稀罕她。
街头卖画的白牧野同样无人理会。
一上午了，没有一个人光顾他的生意。
再这样下去，别说交房租，他自己可能都快要喝西北风了。
关键他的打扮，一点都不像个艺术家。
头上戴着压低帽檐的棒球帽，脸上蒙着大口罩。
这一身打扮若是出现在偏僻点的地方，胆儿小点的见了都得躲着走。
但他是个有节操的人！
色相不能这么廉价的出卖掉！
没人光顾生意，白牧野脑子里也就胡思乱想着，想着老头子说的那些事儿。
想着那座岛。
昨晚在网络上查了半宿，结果毛都没查到。
最后只能无奈的让大漂亮帮他清理掉那些查询记录。
别狐狸没打到再惹一身骚。
想着林子衿。
那个一直出现在他梦里，跟他宿命相依的小女孩，也不知道老头子到底把她送去哪了。
他甚至不知道她在不在飞仙星。
飞仙星地处边陲，又经常会遭到次元空间里爬出来的那些垃圾的攻击。
如果她也在飞仙星，会不会有危险？
content_en:
Chapter 3 Street Painter
In the largest square in the center of the city, Bai Muye sat in a corner with his drawing board in a daze.
I'm still a child!
Isn’t the child’s task to study hard and spend the rest of the time on all sorts of things?
Aren't all other things the parents' responsibility?
Why treat children so cruelly?
In these years, he rarely even leaves the house. The old man is responsible for everything. Where does the money come from?
Because there is not a penny in the account, he can't even overdraw his credit points.
The old man suddenly did this to him and caught him off guard.
Not to mention thinking about his own life experience, he didn't even have time to read the Talisman Seal Master's Manual that the old man left for him.
I don't even have the energy to be sad about the old man's sudden departure.
Was he deliberately trying to temper me this way? At the same time, it makes me less sad that he left?
Pooh!
So sad!
It’s a rhythm that’s going to trick people to death!
Fortunately, I still have some skills. Otherwise, not only would I not be able to pay the rent, I might not even be able to fill my stomach.
Draw the talisman first!
Mental strength is the foundation of a talisman seal master, and the same goes for painting skills!
A great painter may not be a great seal script master, but a great seal script master is definitely a great painter.
I remember that the old man told him that his painting skills were already on par with some famous painters.
When time was tight and he couldn't think of any other means of making a living, he could only think of selling paintings in Baicheng.
But the question is, how much should a painting cost?
Can you earn enough for next month’s rent before school starts?
He has no foundation at all.
And the ideal is always plump, but the reality is very skinny, skinnier than those girls who are so thin that wolves want to cry when they see them.
In fact, few people would care about a girl who is so thin except herself.
Bai Muye, who was selling paintings on the street, was also ignored.
All morning, no one came to his business.
If this continues, let alone paying the rent, he may be about to drink the northwest wind.
The key point is that he doesn't look like an artist at all.
He wore a baseball cap with a lower brim on his head and a large mask covering his face.
If this outfit appeared in a remote place, the timid ones would have to hide away.
But he is a moral person!
Hue cannot be sold so cheaply!
No one came to the business, so Bai Muye was just thinking wildly, thinking about what the old man said.
Thinking about that island.
I searched online for half a night last night, but couldn't find anything.
In the end, he had no choice but to ask Da Meili to help him clean up those query records.
Don't let the fox get into trouble again if you don't hit him.
Thinking of Lin Zijin.
The little girl who kept appearing in his dreams and was destined to depend on him didn't know where the old man had sent her.
He didn't even know if she was on Feixianxing.
Feixianxing is located on the border, and is often attacked by garbage crawling out of the dimensional space.
If she was also on Feixianxing, would she be in danger?
